summary: Acceptance on master ae70cc07 with catalog 9157d27e PASSES: 33/33 cases, 16 available, 17 expected refusals, production worker 33/33 PASS, 0 failures. Every case has the same availability, required-edge and required-door verification, shared-path count and route edge sequence (walks compared by end nodes) as the final-candidate acceptance. 13 available cases report shorter distances (0.106 to 1.299 m). A control run of the same code on master-0388 with catalog 1c3011ff gives exactly the same 33 results as the gap master (every distance equal), so all 13 distance changes come from the code change since the final-candidate acceptance (the November 3 route-output change), not from the gap patches. No acceptance route used a walk through a patched gap, before or after.

control.purpose: separate code effects from data effects: current code (306eadc, Node v22.22.0) on the final-candidate inputs

routeEdgesAndGuides: All 327 route edge uses of the 33 cases are identical between master-0388 and ae70cc07 except the native cell number in walk ids; every guide on those routes is byte-identical between 1c3011ff and 9157d27e.
